sources.title: FinOps Foundation: AI Cost Management Capability
sources.notes: Framework guidance for applying FinOps practices, showback/chargeback, and unit economics to AI workloads.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry: GenAI Semantic Conventions
sources.notes: Standardized attribute and metric definitions for AI instrumentation including gen_ai.system, model, usage tokens, and errors.

sources.title: OpenAI API Pricing and Token Limits
sources.notes: Official model pricing including GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, o1 reasoning models, and prompt caching discounts.

sources.title: Anthropic Claude Pricing and Prompt Caching
sources.notes: Official Claude pricing including 3.5 Sonnet, 3.5 Haiku, and 90% prompt cache read discount terms.

sources.title: Google AI for Developers: Gemini API Pricing
sources.notes: Official Gemini API pricing tiers for 1.5 Flash and 1.5 Pro, including context caching discounts and long-context rates.

sources.title: Amazon Web Services: Amazon Bedrock Pricing
sources.notes: Official managed-model pricing for Bedrock on-demand invocations and Provisioned Throughput hourly commitments.

sources.title: Google Cloud: Model Garden & Vertex AI Pricing
sources.notes: Enterprise Vertex AI and Model Garden serving options, regional rates, and commitment options.

sources.title: Microsoft Azure: Azure OpenAI Service Pricing
sources.notes: Standard pay-as-you-go and Provisioned Throughput Units (PTU) reserved capacity for enterprise OpenAI models.

sources.title: Artificial Analysis: Independent LLM Benchmarks & Quality/Price Frontier
sources.notes: Independent benchmarking of model quality indices, median Time To First Token (TTFT), generation tokens per second (TPS), and price efficiency.

sources.title: vLLM: High-Throughput and Memory-Efficient Inference Engine
sources.notes: Open-source serving architecture, PagedAttention KV-cache management, continuous batching, and self-hosted inference economics.

sources.title: FinOps Foundation: FOCUS™ Open Cost and Usage Specification
sources.notes: Open-standard cloud billing schema normalizing billing and usage across clouds and AI services.

sources.title: LiteLLM: Enterprise AI Gateway & Routing Specification
sources.notes: Production proxy architecture for centralized rate limits, fallbacks, OTel telemetry, and multi-provider load balancing.
